name: Site header
notes: Takes over components/layout/** and components/{Navbar1,Footer}.jsx from the Wave 0 handoff. Builds SiteHeader per docs/contracts/stubs.md #5.1, but consumes the GlobalSearch (SRC) and CartButton (COM) stubs unchanged. menu.js append is the Session group only. Added `docs/lanes/nav.json` to owns (so this amendment itself is in-manifest) and `e2e/tests/navbar.spec.ts` to appends. Note left unresolved, NOT self-amended: components/{Navbar1,Footer}.jsx (named in this same notes field and in the plan's Wave 0 handoff table) were never added to owns/appends, and no other lane claims them either. This lane's implementation avoided depending on them (the new SiteHeader/SiteFooter live entirely under components/layout/**, which is owned), so no amendment was forced — but the gap is real and is flagged in the final report rather than papered over here, since — unlike the e2e spec path — nothing in this lane's own definition of done required touching those two files.
